title: Sharp Bounds on Sustained Improvement Probabilities in Rotating Ordinal Panels
banked_reason: D0.5.G graded the mathematically cleared package subfield below the field floor (paper-score ceiling 6.5 < 7.4) and found no same-scope salvage.
gap_reasons: The frontier does not determine the gain at a particular observed law: the note itself gives a law for which the full endpoint table produces no contraction.
Its optimal-score claim concerns one exactly known population mean after waves 1 and 3 are jointly measured; it establishes neither a cheaper measurement design nor finite-sample precision.
The closest published matching-variable article needs full-text source verification for priority.
proof_attempt_summary: The run proved the sharp all-K population identification frontier, matching extremal laws, the endpoint-score compression result, and the zero-value outside-target overlap result. After a mechanical dependency-edge repair, both D0.5 soundness panels passed without findings. The package nevertheless remained subfield-tier because it lacks law-specific collection gains, finite-sample precision and unequal-cost allocation results, and a complete closest-prior-art check.
tldr: In a baseline-randomized finite-ordinal rotating panel, the sharp adjacent-pair width for sustained strict improvement is at most \(1/2\). Jointly observing waves 1 and 3 lowers the maximal armwise width to \(1/4\) at \(K=3\) and \((K-3)/(2K-5)\) for \(K\ge4\), with exact gain \(1/[2(2K-5)]\) in the latter regime. Among every real-valued endpoint score, one prespecified score \(h_K\) attains the same worst-case guarantee as the full endpoint table. Appended outside-target windows have zero identification value, and representative triple validation identifies the audited event masses.
gap: Adjacent overlapping pairs leave strict three-wave improvement unidentified. Inspected full 2013 and 2017 Conti–Marella–Scanu articles analyze two-margin matching uncertainty and auxiliary restrictions; fixed-margin sources give cell-level results, and causal transport supplies generic LPs. None of these inspected results states the exact all-level strict-event diameter after the complete endpoint pair or the one-score minimax equality. The separate D’Orazio–Di Zio–Scanu 2017 journal full text remains unavailable, so that priority comparison rests on its abstract and the full related proceedings chapter.
fill: Prove the adjacent full-law lift, audit the all-level pair-potential certificate and matching tables, establish the exact triangle and scalar frontiers for both arms, and contrast them with appended-window gluing and representative validation.
